title: Ezekiel's Vision of Idolatry in the Temple
description: In a vision, the prophet Ezekiel is brought to Jerusalem and sees the hidden idolatries taking place in the Lord's temple: the idol that provokes jealousy, seventy elders offering incense to creeping things and detestable animals, women weeping over Tammuz, and men worshiping the sun. Finally, the Lord announces His judgment upon the people.
